title: "UnboundLocalError" on an annotation for a nonlocal variable

labels.name: semantic-analyzer
labels.description: Problems that happen during semantic analysis

body:
This code causes `UnboundLocalError` with mypy 0.711 and the latest master sources (`Version: 0.720+dev.46aa00d8a8d5c870c6ef24b82261b6b257e2ea03`).


```foo.py
#!/usr/bin/env python3

import typing


def main():
    bar = []  # type: typing.List[int]

    def foo():
        nonlocal bar
        bar = []  # type: typing.List[int]


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```
